title: The First YouTube Video Is Only 19 Seconds Long

scenes.text: The first YouTube video is only 19 seconds long.
It was uploaded on April 23, 2005, and it's called Me at the zoo.
Co-founder Jawed Karim stands in front of elephants at the San Diego Zoo.
He just talks about their long trunks.
It now has more than 433 million views.
Nineteen seconds that started YouTube. Watch it again.
